name: MKI Merge Versions
overview: Two resolutions, one entry. The 4K version leads.
description: Merges movies that exist in several resolutions into a single library entry, matched by TMDb ID (IMDb as fallback), never by title. The highest resolution becomes the primary version. Runs as a scheduled task and automatically once the library has been quiet for five minutes. Includes a dry-run mode. Settings page is in German.
changelog: First release: links versions via the database, groups by TMDb/IMDb, highest resolution becomes primary, own settings page.
